comparison.objective: Recover media through a separating screen, versus turning a cake out onto a plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping, agitation and flow regulation versus coordinated pan-and-plate inversion and food release.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered media, retained washers and no spill versus intact cake released and correctly placed on the plate.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual load control, but inversion/release of one fragile body is not selective granular separation.
